name: Magic Romanesque
source:
Beneath the "Human World" lies the "Spirit World".
The protagonist works as a maid in a certain nobles mansion in that spirit world.
Somehow the master of the house "Young Master" has taken an interest in her and chases her around everyday.
Today she had to coldly chase away that merciless boy once again.
She went to her sorcery master "Teacher" to complain, however...

So... It's that kind of thing.
In order to fight back against the young master who makes the maids have to put running away from him in front of their duties, Teacher has gone to have a talk with him.
Probably.

[Translated from official site]
translation:
「人界」之下，是「靈界」。
主角在那個靈界的某個貴族府邸裡擔任女僕。
不知怎的，家主「少爺」對她產生了興趣，每天追著她跑。
今天她必須再次冷酷地趕走那個不肯死心的男孩。
她去找魔法師「老師」訴苦，然而……

所以……就是這樣的事情。
少爺鬧得女僕們忙著逃跑，連工作都顧不上了。為了對付他，老師特地去找少爺談話。
大概。
